<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1, viewport-fit=cover">
<title>Gabriel Mochubela – Junior Developer</title>
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin>
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Bricolage+Grotesque:opsz,wght@12..96,500;12..96,700&family=Instrument+Sans:wght@400;500&family=Playfair+Display:wght@700;900&family=Bebas+Neue&family=Space+Grotesk:wght@700&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
<style>
:root{color-scheme:dark;--bg:#070605;--surface:#100E0A;--ink:#F5F0E8;--muted:#A89F8A;--line:#3A311C;--accent:#C9A84C;--on-accent:#0A0A0A;
box-sizing:border-box;padding-top:env(safe-area-inset-top,0px);padding-bottom:env(safe-area-inset-bottom,0px)}
html{scroll-padding-top:env(safe-area-inset-top,0px);scroll-behavior:smooth}
*,*::before,*::after{box-sizing:inherit}
body{margin:0;background:radial-gradient(60rem 30rem at 85% -5%,rgba(201,168,76,.14),transparent 60%),var(--bg);color:var(--ink);font:400 1.0625rem/1.6 "Instrument Sans",system-ui,-apple-system,"Segoe UI",sans-serif}
h1,h2,h3{font-family:"Bricolage Grotesque","Instrument Sans",system-ui,sans-serif;margin:0;line-height:1.05}
a{color:inherit}
a:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--accent);outline-offset:3px;border-radius:2px}
.wrap{max-width:62rem;margin:0 auto;padding:0 1.5rem;position:relative;z-index:1}
body::before{content:"";position:fixed;inset:-20%;z-index:0;pointer-events:none;background:radial-gradient(40rem 40rem at 20% 30%,rgba(201,168,76,.13),transparent 60%),radial-gradient(36rem 36rem at 80% 70%,rgba(154,116,48,.15),transparent 60%),radial-gradient(28rem 28rem at 55% 10%,rgba(232,201,106,.08),transparent 60%);animation:drift 20s ease-in-out infinite alternate}
@keyframes drift{from{transform:translate(0,0) scale(1)}to{transform:translate(7%,-6%) scale(1.18)}}
#sparkle{position:fixed;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%;z-index:0;pointer-events:none}
button.btn{font:inherit;font-weight:500;background:transparent;color:inherit;cursor:pointer}
header.nav{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;padding:1.5rem 0}
.nav a{text-decoration:none;font-weight:500}
.nav nav{display:flex;gap:1.5rem}
.nav a:hover{color:var(--accent)}
.hero{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.3fr 1fr;gap:3rem;align-items:end;padding:5rem 0 4.5rem}
.hero h1{font-size:clamp(3rem,9vw,6.5rem);font-weight:700;letter-spacing:-.035em}
.hero p.lead{font-size:1.25rem;color:var(--muted);max-width:30rem;margin:1.5rem 0 2rem}
.btns{display:flex;gap:.75rem;flex-wrap:wrap}
.btn{display:inline-block;padding:.75rem 1.4rem;border-radius:6px;font-weight:500;text-decoration:none;border:1.5px solid var(--ink)}
.btn.primary{background:var(--accent);border-color:var(--accent);color:var(--on-accent)}
.btn:hover{transform:translateY(-1px)}.btn.primary:hover{box-shadow:0 8px 28px rgba(201,168,76,.35)}
.log{background:var(--surface);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:14px;box-shadow:0 0 0 1px rgba(201,168,76,.12),0 20px 50px rgba(0,0,0,.35);padding:1.25rem 1.4rem;font-size:.95rem}
.log h2{font-size:1rem;margin-bottom:.9rem;color:var(--muted);font-weight:500}
.log ul{list-style:none;margin:0;padding:0}
.log li{display:flex;gap:.9rem;padding:.55rem 0;border-top:1px solid var(--line);opacity:0;animation:in .5s forwards}
.log li:nth-child(1){animation-delay:.2s}.log li:nth-child(2){animation-delay:.4s}.log li:nth-child(3){animation-delay:.6s}.log li:nth-child(4){animation-delay:.8s}
.log time{color:var(--accent);font-weight:500;min-width:3.4rem}
@keyframes in{from{opacity:0;transform:translateY(6px)}to{opacity:1;transform:none}}
section{padding:3.5rem 0;border-top:1px solid var(--line)}
section>.wrap>h2{font-size:clamp(2rem,4.5vw,3rem);letter-spacing:-.02em;margin-bottom:2rem}
.blocks{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fill,minmax(16rem,1fr));gap:1.25rem}
.proj{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:.7rem;padding:1.5rem;background:var(--surface);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:14px;text-decoration:none}

.logo{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;height:7rem;border-radius:9px;margin-bottom:.5rem;padding:0 1rem;text-align:center;font-size:1.45rem;line-height:1.1}
.lg-fb{background:#0A0A0A;color:#C9A84C;font-family:"Playfair Display",Georgia,serif;font-weight:900;letter-spacing:.05em}
.lg-dd{background:#FAF7F2;color:#0E0E0E;font-family:"Playfair Display",Georgia,serif;font-weight:700}
.lg-dd b{color:#C9A96E}
.lg-ice{background:#f5fcfe;color:#e5661a;font-family:"Bebas Neue",Impact,sans-serif;font-size:2.2rem;letter-spacing:.03em;text-shadow:0 0 12px rgba(255,138,61,.5)}
.lg-tb{background:#f4ede1;color:#2b2620;font-family:Georgia,serif;letter-spacing:.02em}
.lg-gt{background:#070c16;color:#eaf2ff;font-family:"Space Grotesk",system-ui,sans-serif;font-weight:700}
.lg-gt i{width:9px;height:9px;border-radius:50%;background:#f2b705;box-shadow:0 0 10px #f2b705;margin-right:10px}
.lg-gt b{color:#35e0ff}
.proj .yr{align-self:flex-start;font-size:.85rem;color:var(--accent);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:99px;padding:.1rem .75rem}
.proj h3{font-size:1.4rem;letter-spacing:-.01em}
.proj p{margin:.5rem 0 0;color:var(--muted)}
.proj .stack{margin-top:auto;padding-top:.9rem;border-top:1px solid var(--line);color:var(--muted);font-size:.9rem}
.proj{transition:border-color .2s,box-shadow .2s}.proj:hover{border-color:var(--accent);box-shadow:0 12px 34px rgba(0,0,0,.4)}.proj:hover h3{color:var(--accent);text-decoration:underline;text-underline-offset:.2em}
dl{display:grid;grid-template-columns:11rem 1fr;gap:1rem 1.5rem;margin:0}
dt{font-weight:500}
dd{margin:0;color:var(--muted)}
.about{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:3rem}
.about p{margin:0 0 1rem;max-width:34rem}
.jobs{list-style:none;margin:0;padding:0}
.jobs li{padding:.9rem 0;border-top:1px solid var(--line)}
.jobs b{font-weight:500}
.jobs span{display:block;color:var(--muted);font-size:.95rem}
.contact h2{font-size:clamp(2.5rem,7vw,5rem)}
.contact a.mail{font-family:"Bricolage Grotesque",system-ui,sans-serif;font-size:clamp(1.4rem,4vw,2.4rem);color:var(--accent);text-underline-offset:.2em}
footer{padding:2rem 0 3rem;color:var(--muted);font-size:.9rem}
@media (max-width:760px){
.hero{grid-template-columns:1fr;padding:3rem 0}
.blocks{grid-template-columns:1fr}
dl{grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:.2rem}dd{margin-bottom:.8rem}
.about{grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:1.5rem}
}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.log li{animation:none;opacity:1}body::before{animation:none}html{scroll-behavior:auto}.btn:hover{transform:none}}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<canvas id="sparkle" aria-hidden="true"></canvas>
<div class="wrap">
  <header class="nav">
    <a href="#top"><b>Gabriel Mochubela</b></a>
    <nav aria-label="Main"><a href="#work">Work</a><a href="#skills">Skills</a><a href="#about">About</a><a href="#contact">Contact</a></nav>
  </header>

  <main id="top">
    <div class="hero">
      <div>
        <h1>I build clean, modern websites.</h1>
        <p class="lead">Junior developer freelancing since 2025, building websites for barbershops, event décor, online shops, and more.</p>
        <div class="btns"><a class="btn primary" href="#work">See my work</a><a class="btn" href="#contact">Get in touch</a></div>
      </div>
      <aside class="log" aria-label="Recent activity">
        <h2>Recently shipped</h2>
        <ul>
          <li><time>Live</time><span>Fadeful Barber, a barbershop website</span></li>
          <li><time>Live</time><span>Dina's Décor, an event décor site</span></li>
          <li><time>Live</time><span>Devandre's Ice, a neon-styled ice supplier site</span></li>
          <li><time>Live</time><span>Terra &amp; Bloom, a handmade home goods store</span></li>
        </ul>
      </aside>
    </div>
  </main>

  <section id="work" aria-labelledby="work-h">
    <div class="wrap" style="padding:0">
      <h2 id="work-h">Selected work</h2><div class="blocks">
      <a class="proj" href="https://claude.ai/artifact/TN3qYeyNV4Bx8GTHeTL9S6" target="_blank" rel="noopener"><span class="logo lg-fb" aria-hidden="true">Fadeful Barber</span><span class="yr">Grooming</span><div><h3>Fadeful Barber</h3><p>A website for a premium barbershop, showing cuts and grooming services.</p></div><span class="stack">HTML, CSS, JavaScript</span></a>
      <a class="proj" href="https://claude.ai/artifact/6pK9zNgyHR5WcPcxm2HXxn" target="_blank" rel="noopener"><span class="logo lg-dd" aria-hidden="true">Dina's Decor<b>.</b></span><span class="yr">Events</span><div><h3>Dina's Décor</h3><p>An elegant site for an event décor business, built to elevate every occasion.</p></div><span class="stack">HTML, CSS, JavaScript</span></a>
      <a class="proj" href="https://claude.ai/artifact/JpFUnXs6gLSZMAyoZWGFBN" target="_blank" rel="noopener"><span class="logo lg-ice" aria-hidden="true">DEVANDRE'S ICE</span><span class="yr">Supply</span><div><h3>Devandre's Ice</h3><p>A bold neon-styled site for an ice supplier that never runs out.</p></div><span class="stack">HTML, CSS, JavaScript</span></a>
      <a class="proj" href="https://claude.ai/artifact/P8NYBCTqgjHv3HMzdae3ms" target="_blank" rel="noopener"><span class="logo lg-tb" aria-hidden="true">Terra &amp; Bloom</span><span class="yr">Shop</span><div><h3>Terra &amp; Bloom</h3><p>An online store for handmade ceramics, textiles, and botanical pieces from South African studios.</p></div><span class="stack">HTML, CSS</span></a>
      <a class="proj" href="https://claude.ai/artifact/StKrb4W5E6KQ8wQAwGQmXz" target="_blank" rel="noopener"><span class="logo lg-gt" aria-hidden="true"><i></i>Gabriel's<b>TECH</b></span><span class="yr">Consulting</span><div><h3>Gabriel's Technology Consulting</h3><p>A consulting site covering software, security, and infrastructure for growing organisations.</p></div><span class="stack">HTML, CSS, JavaScript</span></a></div>
    </div>
  </section>

  <section id="skills" aria-labelledby="skills-h">
    <div class="wrap" style="padding:0">
      <h2 id="skills-h">Skills</h2>
      <dl>
        <dt>Languages</dt><dd>HTML, CSS, JavaScript, Python</dd>
        <dt>Frontend</dt><dd>Responsive, mobile-friendly layouts</dd>
        <dt>Learning</dt><dd>More JavaScript, backend development, and frameworks</dd>
        <dt>Tools</dt><dd>Git and GitHub</dd>
      </dl>
    </div>
  </section>

  <section id="about" aria-labelledby="about-h">
    <div class="wrap" style="padding:0">
      <h2 id="about-h">About</h2>
      <div class="about">
        <div>
          <p>I'm a junior developer who has been freelancing since 2025. I enjoy turning ideas into clean, good-looking websites that work well on any screen.</p>
          <p>I'm building a portfolio of real projects and learning something new with every build.</p>
        </div>
        <ul class="jobs">
          <li><b>Freelance Web Developer</b><span>2025 to now</span></li>
          <li><b>Built four websites</b><span>Barbershop, event décor, ice supplier, online store</span></li>
          <li><b>Open to junior roles and freelance work</b><span>Get in touch below</span></li>
        </ul>
      </div>
    </div>
  </section>

  <section id="contact" class="contact" aria-labelledby="contact-h">
    <div class="wrap" style="padding:0">
      <h2 id="contact-h">Let's work together.</h2>
      <p>I'm open to new roles and freelance projects.</p>
      <a class="mail" href="mailto:gabrielmochubela9@gmail.com">gabrielmochubela9@gmail.com</a><br><a class="mail" href="tel:+27686942018">068 694 2018</a>
      <div class="btns" style="margin-top:1.5rem"><a class="btn" href="https://github.com/Gabrielmochubela9-png" target="_blank" rel="noopener">GitHub</a><a class="btn" href="https://www.linkedin.com/in/gabriel-mochubela-411482421" target="_blank" rel="noopener">LinkedIn</a><a class="btn" href="https://www.instagram.com/ur.boy_drago" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Instagram</a><button class="btn" id="cv" type="button">Download CV</button></div>
    </div>
  </section>

  <p id="cvmsg" role="status" style="color:var(--muted);font-size:.9rem;min-height:1.4rem;margin:.75rem 0 0"></p>
  <footer>© 2026 Gabriel Mochubela</footer>
</div>

<script>
(function(){
var c=document.getElementById('sparkle');if(!c)return;
var x=c.getContext('2d'),w,h,ps=[],raf,reduce=matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce)').matches;
function mk(init){return{x:Math.random()*w,y:init?Math.random()*h:h+10,r:Math.random()*1.6+.4,v:Math.random()*.15+.03,p:Math.random()*6.28,s:Math.random()*.02+.008,c:Math.random()<.25?'240,214,130':'201,168,76'}}
function size(){var d=Math.min(window.devicePixelRatio||1,2);w=window.innerWidth;h=window.innerHeight;c.width=w*d;c.height=h*d;x.setTransform(d,0,0,d,0,0);var n=Math.round(Math.min(110,w*h/14000));ps=[];for(var i=0;i<n;i++)ps.push(mk(true));if(reduce)draw()}
function draw(){x.clearRect(0,0,w,h);
for(var i=0;i<ps.length;i++){var p=ps[i];
if(!reduce){p.y-=p.v;p.p+=p.s;if(p.y<-10){ps[i]=mk(false);continue}}
var a=reduce?.7:.25+.75*Math.abs(Math.sin(p.p));
x.globalAlpha=a;x.fillStyle='rgb('+p.c+')';x.shadowColor='rgb('+p.c+')';x.shadowBlur=8;
x.beginPath();x.arc(p.x,p.y,p.r,0,6.283);x.fill();
if(p.r>1.3){x.shadowBlur=0;x.strokeStyle='rgb('+p.c+')';x.lineWidth=.6;x.beginPath();x.moveTo(p.x-p.r*4,p.y);x.lineTo(p.x+p.r*4,p.y);x.moveTo(p.x,p.y-p.r*4);x.lineTo(p.x,p.y+p.r*4);x.stroke()}}
x.globalAlpha=1;x.shadowBlur=0;
if(!reduce)raf=requestAnimationFrame(draw)}
window.addEventListener('resize',size);
size();if(!reduce)raf=requestAnimationFrame(draw);
})();

(function(){
var CV='';
var btn=document.getElementById('cv'),msg=document.getElementById('cvmsg');
if(!btn)return;
function say(t){if(msg)msg.textContent=t}
btn.addEventListener('click',async function(){
try{
var dl=window.claude&&window.claude.use?await window.claude.use('downloads'):null;
if(!dl){say('Downloads are not available in this view.');return}
var bin=atob(CV),u=new Uint8Array(bin.length);for(var i=0;i<bin.length;i++)u[i]=bin.charCodeAt(i);
await dl.save({filename:'Gabriel-Mochubela-CV.pdf',data:new Blob([u],{type:'application/pdf'})});
say('CV saved.');
}catch(e){
if(e&&e.code==='declined'){say('')}
else if(e&&e.code==='rate_limited'){say('Please wait a moment and try again.')}
else{say('Could not download the CV. Please email me and I will send it.')}
}
});
})();
</script>
</body>
</html>
